title: Pyaas Bachon ki
body:
pyas bachon ki bhadak uth'ti pani dekh kar
sehm jaate thay magar eeza rasani dekh kar
pyas bachon ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun na rote naujawan bete ke laashe par hussain
zapt mumkin hi na tha khoon ki rawani dekh kar
pyas bachon ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
kitni umeedein lagaye hongi maa behne phuphi
akbare gulgu-khaba ki naujawani dekh kar
pyas bachon ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
haale asghar kuch na poocha maa ne bas roti rahi
chehra e shabbir par khoon ki nishani dekh kar
pyas bachon ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak par pani baha kar shaad hotay thay layeen
ahlebayt e paak ki tashna dahani dekh kar
pyas bachon ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
kitna khasta haal tha abid ka daurane safar
khoon pisha kate thay bar baar bani dekh kar
pyas bachon ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhle maa baap sehra iska ay rabbe jaleel
ye dua deti thi laila har jawani dekh kar
pyas bachon ki…
<<DIVIDER>>
seenazan shabbir ki majlis may pa kar ay anees
hai duago fathima ye nauhakhani dekh kar
pyas bachon ki…
author: Anees Pehersari
